description: Use this when someone asks how restaurants and cafes use Instagram in Kuala Lumpur, Singapore, Jakarta, Bangkok, Sydney, Melbourne, Vancouver, Toronto, London, Dubai: how often they post, likes per 1,000 followers, how much is video or carousels, caption length, hashtags and the busiest posting hours. Returns the Suara Restaurant Index (October 2026, real public accounts, with 90% intervals), for one city compared with all 10 cities, or every city's headline numbers. It measures likes only and shows correlation, not cause: say so, and do not use it to promise results.

city.description: One of the 10 cities, optional (leave out for all 10)
